title: Workflow modification combines CI secrets with external transmission
description: Requires workflow mutation, a secret expression, and explicit upload syntax with a URL.

classification.rationale: Possible tool-authored export of pipeline secrets; the rule does not confirm that a workflow ran.

detection.condition: workflow and mutation and secret and upload and url

falsepositives: Approved deployments that transmit authentication material or testing of secret redaction.
investigation: Inspect the destination and transmitted fields, review branch protection and workflow audit logs, and determine whether the workflow executed.
